summary: Known community.general issue: the homectl and udm_user modules don't work on Python 3.13+ because they rely on the removed crypt standard library module.
questions: Why does homectl fail on Python 3.13?
Does udm_user work with Python 3.13 or newer?

answer_card.title: homectl and udm_user fail on Python 3.13
answer_card.answer_md: `community.general.homectl` and `udm_user` use the `crypt` module, which was removed in Python 3.13. They won't work on Python 3.13 or newer.
